Given $af\left(x\right) + bf\left(\dfrac{1}{x}\right) = x + 1 . . . \left(i\right)$

Replacing $x \to \dfrac{1}{x}$, we get

$af\left(\dfrac{1}{x}\right) + bf\left(x\right) = \dfrac{1}{x} + 1 . . . \left(ii\right)$

$a \times \left(i\right) - b \times \left(ii\right)$, we get

$\left({a}^{2} - {b}^{2}\right)f\left(x\right) = ax - \dfrac{b}{x} + a - b$

$f\left(x\right) = \dfrac{ax - \dfrac{b}{x}}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} + \dfrac{1}{a + b}$

Now, $\dfrac{d}{dx}\left({x}^{2}f\left(x\right)\right) = \dfrac{d}{dx}\left({x}^{2}\left(\dfrac{ax - \dfrac{b}{x}}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} + \dfrac{1}{a + b}\right)\right)$

$= \dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\left(\dfrac{a{x}^{3} - bx}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} + \dfrac{{x}^{2}}{a + b}\right)\right) = \dfrac{3a{x}^{2} - b}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} + \dfrac{2x}{a + b}$

Given, $\dfrac{3a{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} + \dfrac{2x}{a + b} - \dfrac{b}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} = 2{x}^{2} + 2x + \dfrac{1}{3}$

i.e. $\dfrac{3a}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} = 2$,

$\dfrac{1}{a + b} = 1$ and 

$- \dfrac{b}{{a}^{2} - {b}^{2}} = \dfrac{1}{3}$

So, $\dfrac{a}{a - b} = \dfrac{2}{3} \text{ and } - \dfrac{b}{a - b} = \dfrac{1}{3}$

i.e. $a = - 2b ⇒ b = - 1, a = 2$

Hence, $a - b = 3$

$⇒ \dfrac{{d}^{2}y}{d{x}^{2}} = - \left[\dfrac{( ab - {h}^{2} ) y + ( {h}^{2} - ab ) x\dfrac{dy}{dx}}{( hx + by{)}^{2}}\right]$

$⇒ \dfrac{{d}^{2}y}{d{x}^{2}} = - ( ab - {h}^{2} ) \left[\dfrac{y - x\dfrac{dy}{dx}}{( hx + by{)}^{2}}\right]$

Now, put $\dfrac{dy}{dx} = - \dfrac{\left(ax + hy\right)}{( hx + by )}$

$⇒ \dfrac{{d}^{2}y}{d{x}^{2}} = - \left(ab - {h}^{2}\right)\left[\dfrac{y - x\left(- \dfrac{\left(ax + hy\right)}{( hx + by )}\right)}{( hx + by{)}^{2}}\right]$

$⇒ \dfrac{{d}^{2}y}{d{x}^{2}} = - \left(ab - {h}^{2}\right)\left[\dfrac{a{x}^{2} + 2hxy + b{y}^{2}}{( hx + by{)}^{2}}\right]$

As given $a{x}^{2} + 2hxy + b{y}^{2} = 0$

So, $\dfrac{{d}^{2}y}{d{x}^{2}} = 0$

$\Rightarrow \quad x \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+y \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\tan u$
